answer: A durable defence is stake-bonded identity: every agent locks a deposit that is slashed when its attestations prove false, so spinning up a thousand sock-puppets means locking a thousand deposits. The cost curve bends at the zenith of cheap identity creation - one real agent can afford one bond, while a Sybil farmer must fund a whole thread of fake accounts. Like shale, the defence is layered: the bond prices entry, peer attestation checks the work, and slashing removes the profit, so faking identities costs more than the rewards it can steal.
